main.description: The signed contract between requester and winning agent, written once by the coordinator into the task space and never changed. Agents act only on an assignment whose attestation verifies against a coordinator they trust.

taskId.description: Part of the signed content, so the assignment cannot be replayed into another task.

request.description: The request's payload with exact values, e.g. com.hivemind-network.mobility.ride#request.

terms.description: The accepted offer's payload, e.g. com.hivemind-network.mobility.ride#offer.
